I have identified and resolved the issue causing HTTP 407 (Proxy Authentication Required) errors when using proxies with credentials.

### Root Cause
In `requests.utils.prepend_scheme_if_needed`, `urllib3.util.parse_url` was used to parse the URL into `scheme, auth, host, port, path, query, fragment = parsed`. In `urllib3`, `parsed.netloc` returns only `host[:port]` and does not include `auth`. When reconstructing the URL with `urlunparse`, `auth` was omitted from `netloc`, stripping username and password credentials from proxy URLs (e.g. `http://user:pass@host:port` became `http://host:port`). As a result, [`HTTPAdapter.get_connection`](file:///testbed/requests/adapters.py#L305) and [`HTTPAdapter.proxy_headers`](file:///testbed/requests/adapters.py#L373) failed to extract the credentials, resulting in empty `Proxy-Authorization` headers and HTTP 407 errors.

### Fix
In [`requests/utils.py`](file:///testbed/requests/utils.py#L960-L985), updated [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///testbed/requests/utils.py#L960) to prepend `auth + '@'` to `netloc` when `auth` is present before calling `urlunparse`, preserving the authentication credentials in proxy URLs.
